subject.title: feat(android): syntax-highlighted code blocks in chat

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Android in-repo syntax highlighter after the release-owned changelog edit is removed?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but it adds a user-facing Android rendering feature and owned tokenizer; accepting that maintenance direction is a maintainer product choice, not a mechanical cleanup decision.

options.title: Accept after changelog cleanup
options.body: Remove the `CHANGELOG.md` edit, keep the PR-body release-note context, and let maintainers land the Android implementation once required checks are green.

options.title: Defer to the umbrella issue
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep Android syntax highlighting tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100195 if maintainers want a different renderer strategy.

recommendation.title: Accept after changelog cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the `CHANGELOG.md` edit, keep the PR-body release-note context, and let maintainers land the Android implementation once required checks are green.
